info.title: Gendut Grosir API
info.description: Backend for the Gendut Grosir point-of-sale and inventory app. Authenticate with `POST /login` and send the returned `accessToken` as a Bearer token.

tags.name: Roles
tags.description: Roles and the app features each role may access

get.description: Returns the raw mongoose document spread into the response, so the user fields are under `_doc` (with the populated role) alongside mongoose internals.

put.description: Edit the logged-in user's name, email, password and profile picture. All fields are optional. `currentPassword` is required when changing `email` or `password`. Send as `multipart/form-data` to upload a new profile picture as `image`.
Requires an `admin` or `super_admin` role. `status` defaults to `retail` when omitted.

post.description: Only succeeds while the roles collection is empty.

put.description: `allows` must include `pos`. The `super_admin` role cannot be changed.

get.description: Unlike most list endpoints, the paginated result is returned without an envelope.

200.description: Deleted category (null if it did not exist)

post.description: Requires an `admin` or `super_admin` role. Send as `multipart/form-data` to attach an image.

put.description: Requires an `admin` or `super_admin` role. Send as `multipart/form-data` to replace the image.

get.description: Requires an `admin` or `super_admin` role. `q` filters by order id.

post.description: Decrements stock for each line item. Lines whose product has insufficient stock are silently dropped from the saved order (totals are still computed from the request).

parameters.name: orderId
parameters.description: Human-readable order id, not the Mongo _id

put.summary: Cancel an order and restock its items

parameters.name: orderId
parameters.description: Human-readable order id, not the Mongo _id

get.description: **Unauthenticated and destructive:** rewrites every order `date` to a random time up to 30 days before its `createdAt`. Intended for seeding demo data only.
Requires an `admin` or `super_admin` role. `q` filters by opname id.

post.description: Requires an `admin` or `super_admin` role. With `apply: true`, each product's stock is set to its `realQty` immediately.

put.description: Requires an `admin` or `super_admin` role. Sets each product's stock to its counted `realQty`.

post.description: Requires an `admin` or `super_admin` role. JPEG, PNG, GIF or WebP, up to 10 MB each.

get.description: Defaults to the current month when `start`/`end` are omitted. `end` is inclusive.
